region.Description: Desikan-Killiany / FreeSurfer aseg region of the bipolar channel (bip_montage_region in the release)

soz_region_label.Description: Whether the channel's Desikan-Killiany region is one of the patient's seizure-onset-zone regions in the deposit results JSON (per-patient per-region SOZ labels used by Sundrani et al. 2025; SOZ defined per DK region containing any contact involved in ictal onset of at least one seizure). n/a: region not evaluated or patient absent from the results JSON.
